Brighton and Hove is a thriving area with strong demand for reliable full bathroom installation and fitting services. Local properties range from period Victorian and Edwardian homes through to modern new-build developments, each presenting different plumbing requirements and challenges.

Our Gas Safe registered engineers serve all areas of Brighton and Hove and the surrounding East Sussex region. Whether you're in the town centre or the surrounding residential areas, we provide prompt, professional bathroom installation services with transparent pricing and no hidden call-out charges.

With years of experience working across East Sussex, our engineers understand the specific plumbing challenges faced by local homeowners. From the older pipe infrastructure common in period properties to the modern systems found in newer developments, our team has the expertise to handle any full bathroom installation and fitting requirement.

We cover all postcodes across Brighton and Hove with same-day availability for urgent work. All our engineers are fully qualified, insured, and committed to leaving your property clean and tidy after every job.

faqs.q: Can you move the toilet and bath to different positions?
faqs.a: Yes, but it depends on the soil pipe route and floor structure. Moving a toilet more than a metre from the existing soil stack requires a new soil pipe connection and increases cost significantly.

faqs.q: How much does a bathroom installation cost?
faqs.a: Labour for a full bathroom installation typically ranges from £2,500 to £5,000 depending on complexity. Suite and tile costs are separate. A complete bathroom renovation including all materials typically costs £4,000 to £10,000+.

faqs.q: Should I supply my own bathroom suite or let the plumber supply it?
faqs.a: You can do either. Supplying your own suite gives you more choice and control over the brand and style. Your installer may offer trade discounts worth 15-30% off RRP if they supply.

faqs.q: What guarantees should I expect on a bathroom installation?
faqs.a: Expect a minimum 12-month labour guarantee. Manufacturer warranties on suites and fittings typically run 5-25 years depending on the brand. Get all guarantees in writing.

localParagraph: Brighton and Hove presents an interesting mix of challenges and considerations for bathroom installation, largely due to its diverse housing stock and variable water conditions across the city. The area encompasses everything from grand Regency terraces along the seafront and in Kemp Town to Victorian conversions in Hanover, interwar semis in Patcham, and modern new-builds further inland — each era of construction bringing its own pipework quirks, floor structures, and space constraints that experienced installers need to account for. Water hardness in Brighton and Hove sits in a mixed range, meaning some properties will benefit from integrated water softeners or scale-resistant components as part of a new bathroom fit, particularly in areas drawing harder water through older supply lines. Working in England's planning framework also means that listed buildings and conservation zones, which are plentiful across central Brighton, may require additional consideration before structural or plumbing changes are made. A skilled local installer will understand how these factors combine, tailoring each project to the specific property rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach.
whatItInvolves: A full bathroom installation covers everything from stripping out the existing suite to fitting the new one — including all pipework, waste connections, tiling preparation, flooring, and electrical work for lighting and extraction. A quality bathroom installation transforms one of the most-used rooms in your home and typically adds 3-5% to your property value.
process: The process starts with a detailed survey to assess existing pipework, drainage routes, and structural considerations. Day 1-2: strip out and prep. Day 3-4: first fix plumbing and any structural work. Day 5-7: suite installation, tiling, and second fix. Day 8-10: finishing, sealant, and final inspection. You'll be without a working bathroom for 5-10 days depending on complexity — we'll agree a realistic timeline upfront.
whatToExpect: Expect a detailed written quote covering labour, waste disposal, and any structural work. Suite and tiles are usually supplied separately by you or sourced through us. All plumbing work is carried out to Water Regulations standards. A bathroom installation is a major investment — ask to see previous work and Gas Safe registration before committing to any installer.
